items.title: Traditional Japanese House
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Feel like you are shrunk and explore a massive high quality traditional Kyoto house. Hanafuda cards are hidden in various places around the house.

-Also good for PvP.
-Fly freely with the Elytra
-Look for 28 Hanafuda's (Japanese playing cards)

-Built by Team-KYO

items.title: Neon Demons
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Mischievous rainbows, neon demons, here to add a bit of colorful spice to your life. Let your evil side glow with these 14 devilish skins.

items.title: Creeper Pasta
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Who knew a creeper could be so creepy! Taking on the likes of Laughing Jack, Sally Williams, Ticci Toby. Good luck surviving those nightmares! 12 horror-story-themed mob skins in all. Take this summer to a new spooky level.

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Skins of the Month - July
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Fireworks in the sky, dogs on the grill, sandals in the sun, parties by the pool. We're in the heat of summer and these skins are here and specially crafted for it. Basketball players, doge grill masters, hula sharks, a sun goddess, perfect barbeque outfits, and more! 14 July-inspired skins in all.

items.title: Parkour
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Are you the next parkour champion? Can you beat all levels in this challenging world? Well, put on your jumping shoes and proof it! This map is the ultimate jump and run map to test, train and improve your parkour skills! Good luck!

+ PC, mobile & console friendly
+ Dropper
+ Power ups!

items.title: Teen Summer - Hot Hats
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s the good old summertime! Have a hot time summer in the city when you choose from 12 different teen skins complete with hip, hot hats. Look super cute when you role-play in colorful clothes with matching cool caps. You’re sure a stylish teenager now!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Underwater Glow
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Light up the sea and make it glimmer! With 12 underwater skins to choose from, dive down and see what’s on the ocean floor. Role-play as a glowing aquatic creature or Minecraft mob who lives under the sea, showing off all your brilliance. Divers love to see all the shiny sea life!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cliffs Camouflage
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Get excited about cliffs! Turn into ice or snow building blocks in these ultra-new and modern skins. Blend in as leaves, grass, or logs when you role-play hanging out in the snow-capped mountains. Relax and breathe pure air! 

1 free skin included!

items.title: Lucky Blocks!
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Will you be lucky? Enchanted tools and items, snow golems or a horde of zombies—anything is possible when you break a Lucky Block!

+ Craftable Lucky Blocks!
+ Over 200 different outcomes!

(The Lucky Blocks are only useable with the world provided!)
items.changelog:
- Fully reworked the world & behavior pack
- Added new custom terrain and structures
- Lucky Blocks now drops items, blocks and mobs up to 1.21.130

items.title: Egyptian Rush
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Treasure defender is back with an epic Egyptian style map! Are you ready to protect the ancient cursed loot from these treacherous mobs? Complete the challenging journey through the Egyptian lands to earn the victory of protecting the treasure! 
* Shops!
* Multiplayer fun!
* Upgradable gear!
* Rush, protect & conquer!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: MASK UP
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
MASK UP includes 10 fun skins with masks. This pack includes a demon, emoji, clown and more funny masks. Take on the world with these awesome skins!
*Great for roleplay, survival, and PvP

items.title: One Block Lucky Block
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
This map combines the one block challenge with lucky blocks! Grow your base and expand based on lucky or unlucky outcomes. A flock of animals, black concrete, a horde of zombies, great armor, you name it, anything could come out!
+ Skyblock with one lucky block
+ Unlock new islands
+ Gather more and more blocks and try to survive
+ Play alone or with friends

items.title: Mobs Black & White!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The mobs have lost all their color!
Pick up this pack featuring super unique black and white mobs!

+ 12 skins with 2 that are FREE!
+ Includes monochrome skins!

items.title: Demons in Suits
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Become amazing stylish demons with these costumes, haunting the most elegant parties.

+ 12 skins
+ 2 free skins

items.title: Neon Striped Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Shine bright and be bold with one of these 16 neon striped dream skins! Whether you are exploring the city or just want to show off your rich clothes, these stripes will make you look fantastic. 

- 16 teen skins
- Includes 1 free skin
- Great for everyone

items.title: Weapons 2.0
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
135+ New modded weapons, tools, and magic staffs. Craft the Emerald Sword, craft the Bedrock Pickaxe, and craft your set of Ender Armor to bring your game to the next level.

+ 112 New modded weapons and tools
+ 3 New custom armor sets
+ 7 Enchanted magic staffs

items.title: Skeletons
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: You are long past the point of living as you have been undead for a millennia. Without a body existence has become rather complicated. You scare off lone adventurers, horde valuables atop your castle tower, and wander caves in darkness.

items.title: Fashion Teens HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: These teens have style! Be the best dressed in your group as one of these trendy and fashionable teens!

items.title: Rocket Launch
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
The crew cant take off without your help. Come down to the bunker and help us take off! Custom quests, models and so much more to explore!

- Custom models
- Custom terrain
- Custom quests

By BBB Studios

items.title: Bubblegum City
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Explore this beautiful island made just to look like bubblegum! Enjoy the giant mansion with a view of the entire island just for yourself! Live, sleep, and breathe in a fantasy world!

+ Giant 300x300 island!
+ Beautiful fantasy-style build!

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Gentlemen & Ladies
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Glitter and shine wherever you go! Everyone will have an eye on you and you will be the coolest player out there. Choose your favorite skin right now and start flaunting!

+ 12 skins (2 free skins!)
+ Perfect for gentlemen and ladies
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Gamer Slimes
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
These slimes are no noobs and proven they're ready to race, place blocks, or whatever games have them do! The sky is the limit for their potential! They're ready to try for the high score and prove they're skilled and not just lucky!

- Contains 5 neon RGB gamer themed slime skins!
- Do you deserve to rank number one amongst these pros?

items.title: Solar Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
As the sun rises and sets, the rift in the sky grows wider and the solar horrors come to prey! Do you have a bucket of water and a shield to block their fiery attacks? Is one warrior enough to stand against their fusion-empowered hordes?

- Includes twelve fiery solar glitch skins!
- Are you lucky enough to see them and survive?

items.title: Rainbow Armor
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Wear these brightly colored armors now and dazzle other players eyes!

- 10 colorful armors!
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios
